questions.question_english: Which statement best describes how the RTI Act relates to the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 for disclosure of official information?
options_english: The CCS (Conduct) Rules prohibit every disclosure and completely override the RTI Act.
The RTI Act governs non-gazetted officers, while CCS Rules govern gazetted civil servants.
Good-faith disclosure under the RTI Act is protected and does not breach the CCS (Conduct) Rules.
The RTI Act never permits public officials to disclose official information.
questions.explanation_english: Good-faith disclosure under RTI is protected and does not breach CCS (Conduct) Rules. Section 21 provides statutory immunity for actions performed in good faith under the RTI Act, while Section 22 gives the Act overriding effect over conflicting rules. Disclosing official records in accordance with RTI provisions is legally protected and does not constitute an unauthorized release of official information under civil service conduct rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: RTI अधिनियम के अंतर्गत सद्भावना से किया गया प्रकटीकरण संरक्षित है और अपने-आप CCS (Conduct) Rules का उल्लंघन नहीं है। स्रोत में दी गई व्याख्या और संबंधित वैधानिक प्रावधान इस विकल्प का समर्थन करते हैं।

questions.question_english: A citizen files an RTI application asking for the reasons behind a specific policy decision taken by the Directorate of Education. Which of the following is the legally correct stance for the PIO?
options_english: The PIO must justify the administrative decision and draft a complete rationale for the applicant.
The PIO must transfer the application to the Minister of Education for clarification.
The PIO must supply existing records containing reasons, but need not formulate new reasons.
The PIO must reject the request because government policy decisions are exempt.
questions.explanation_english: The PIO must supply existing records containing reasons, but need not formulate new reasons. Section 2(f) requires Public Information Officers to provide information available in recorded form. When an applicant asks for reasons behind a policy decision, the officer must supply existing records, file notings, or documents containing those reasons. The officer is not legally required to draft or generate new justifications not on record.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: PIO को मौजूदा अभिलेख देने चाहिए जिनमें कारण दर्ज हों, लेकिन नए कारण गढ़ने की आवश्यकता नहीं है। RTI के अंतर्गत उपलब्ध या अभिलेख में दर्ज सूचना दी जाती है; लोक प्राधिकरण को नई राय, कारण या विश्लेषण तैयार करना सामान्यतः आवश्यक नहीं होता।
key_facts: Answer key: (C)
Correct option (English): The PIO must supply existing records containing reasons, but need not formulate new reasons.

questions.question_english: Consider the following statements regarding the Right to Information: I. Every kind of intellectual-property information is automatically exempt from disclosure. II. File notings form part of official records. III. RTI access concerns information held by or under the control of a public authority. Which statements are correct?
options_english: II and III only
I and II only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: II and III only File notings are part of official records under Section 2(i) and are disclosable unless specifically exempt under Section 8.
